mechanism: Benazepril may increase atomoxetine levels through CYP2D6 inhibition and reduced renal clearance via blood pressure lowering; atomoxetine has sympathomimetic effects that may counteract benazepril's antihypertensive action.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and consider alternative ADHD medication; if continued together, assess for reduced antihypertensive efficacy and atomoxetine accumulation.
